Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)]]: R5-D4's motivator blows in a cloud of smoke at the Lars homestead on Tatooine in ''Star Wars'' (1977), as Luke Skywalker and C-3PO turn round. Luke then tells Owen Lars "This R2 unit has a bad motivator", and Owen takes R2-D2 instead.

Source: a frame at 0:42 of [https://www.starwars.com/video/bad-motivator Bad Motivator], StarWars.com, the official Lucasfilm clip of the scene (1280 by 720 pixels). The letterbox bars were removed and the frame reduced to 1000 by 427 pixels. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261007112431/https://www.starwars.com/video/bad-motivator Internet Archive], 7 October 2026. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 36f1af640d6bfb0fb5c4d4f69011ae7802150cf05a238cf768fcc3d4f6d6540c.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single reduced-size still from ''Star Wars'' (1977), © Lucasfilm Ltd., used only to show the scene the card's lore refers to, beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
